comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record terminates and trims a wire on a 110 block.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part spring-prong alignment and screw fastening versus orientation-sensitive punch-down force, insulation-displacement seating, and cutting.
comparison.success_condition: Four fully engaged prongs and prescribed screws versus conductor depth/alignment, contact opening, loose-end trimming, intact run, and tool withdrawal.
comparison.reason: Both use controlled insertion force, but the termination/cutting operation and its electrical success state are materially different.
